title: Account Developmet Representative
jobDescription: The Opportunity Go Comet's largest accounts span multiple subsidiaries, geographies, and business units. Each one represents a significant expansion opportunity — and each one needs someone sharp enough to find it, map it, and move it forward. That is what this role does. As an ADR, you sit inside one strategic account, working directly with the Key Account Manager. Your job is to make sure the KAM always knows where the next opportunity is, walks into every meeting fully prepared, and never has to chase an internal update. You are the intelligence, the preparation, and the coordination behind one of Go Comet's most important relationships. It is the fastest way into enterprise account management at Go Comet. What You Will Own Account Intelligence Map every subsidiary, business unit, and geography within the account — who is live, who is in pipeline, who is whitespace Track stakeholder changes, business developments, and supply chain news relevant to the account Prepare a sharp pre-meeting brief for the KAM before every significant client interaction Expansion Pipeline Conduct warm outreach to subsidiary and regional stakeholders, using the parent account relationship as the entry point Qualify opportunities before the KAM engages — budget, decision-maker, timing, existing tools Maintain a live expansion tracker and hand off qualified leads to the KAM with a clear brief Governance & Coordination Own Steer Co preparation end-to-end — deck, agenda, attendee coordination, and action tracking Keep CRM updated at all times — account status, contacts, renewal dates, pipeline Coordinate with CSM, Support, and Solutions so nothing lands on the KAM's desk that should not be there Content & Communication Build QBR decks, account health summaries, and expansion proposals under the KAM's direction Pull platform usage data, Ro I metrics, and adoption numbers from internal teams for client-facing use What We Are Looking For 0–4 years in B2B Saa S, enterprise sales, account management, consulting, or a related field Clear, confident communicator — written and verbal Organised and proactive — able to manage multiple priorities across a complex account without being told what to do next Comfortable with CRM tools and building structured presentations Genuine curiosity about how large enterprises operate Bonus: Exposure to logistics, supply chain, or multi-geography enterprise accounts What This Role Is Not Not a cold-calling role. Not an admin role. Not a role where you wait to be told what to do. You are embedded in a strategic account, working with senior people, on problems that matter. The expectation is that you bring your own thinking — not just execution. title: Project Manager – Enterprise Implementations
jobDescription: The Program Manager will lead the end-to-end implementation lifecycle for our highest- value enterprise customers. This role is designed for a strategic leader who can manage high-ticket accounts, navigating complex organizational structures to ensure Go Comet’s solutions are integrated deeply into the client's global supply chain. You will act as a senior consultant and bridge between C-suite stakeholders and internal technical teams to drive digital transformation. Key Responsibilities Strategic Implementation & Program Governance End-to-End Leadership: Oversee the full project lifecycle for high-ticket enterprise clients, ensuring alignment with large-scale corporate objectives. Process Architecture: Map complex global logistics processes (SOPs, flow charts) and align them with Go Comet’s multi-modal platform. Gap & Risk Analysis: Conduct deep-dive gap analyses and provide strategic recommendations to enhance operational efficiency for global enterprises. Enterprise Relationship Management C-Level Engagement: Foster and maintain long-term relationships with CXOs, COOs, and senior supply chain heads. Onboarding & Health: Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise stakeholders, monitoring account health scores and driving high-level product adoption. Value Realization: Proactively identify business challenges and provide data-driven solutions to maximize the client's ROI. Reporting & Cross-Functional Leadership Executive Reporting: Provide high-level monthly and quarterly status updates to internal leadership and client stakeholders. Metric Tracking: Manage key performance indicators (KPIs) including implementation success rates and project delivery quality. Innovation Catalyst: Work cross-functionally with Product and Tech teams to funnel enterprise- level feedback into the product roadmap. Technical Literacy: Mastery of project management methodologies and tools like JIRA, Asana, or Trello. Data Driven: Exceptional ability to analyze complex data sets, derive strategic insights, and present findings to executive audiences. Communication: Elite stakeholder management skills with the "emotional intelligence" required to navigate high-pressure enterprise environments. Tools: High proficiency in MS Excel and experience with enterprise documentation. Bonus Points Deep expertise in the global logistics and supply chain industry. title: Senior Customer Success Implementation Manager
jobDescription:
The Customer Success Manager (CSIM) plays a pivotal role in driving customer success by overseeing project implementation, business analysis, and strategic execution. The role requires managing the endto-end implementation of Go Comet’s solutions, from requirement gathering to execution, ensuring Customer satisfaction and long-term retention. The CSM will act as a bridge between clients, internal teams, and stakeholders, ensuring smooth project rollout, process mapping, and continuous product adoption. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Project Implementation & Business Analysis · Lead and oversee the end-to-end project implementation lifecycle for new and existing clients. · Finalize Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and obtain necessary approvals/sign- offs. · Develop and execute implementation plans, ensuring alignment with client objectives. · Map customer processes (flow charts, SOPs) and align them with Go Comet's solutions. · Conduct gap analysis and provide recommendations to enhance operational efficiency. Customer Success & Relationship Management · Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring seamless onboarding and adoption. · Foster strong relationships with C-level executives (CXOs, COOs) and key stakeholders. · Work proactively to identify challenges and provide solutions to optimize customer experience. · Monitor customer health scores, ensuring product utilization and satisfaction. Project Documentation & Reporting · Maintain detailed project documentation, ensuring clarity and compliance. · Provide weekly/monthly project status updates to internal teams and clients. · Track key project metrics, ensuring timely execution and quality delivery. Process Optimization & Internal Collaboration · Identify areas of process improvement and implement best practices. · Work cross-functionally with product, sales, and tech teams to drive innovation. · Contribute internal process improvement initiatives and team knowledge sharing. Key Performing Index · Customer onboarding & activation TAT · Project implementation success rate · BRD completion & approval timelines · Customer engagement & product adoption rates · CSAT (Customer Satisfaction) score · Process improvement contributions Key Requirements Must-Have Skills & Qualifications .2+ years of experience in customer success, business analysis, or project management. · Strong understanding of project implementation methodologies and process mapping. · Experience in preparing and finalizing BRDs, project documentation, and implementation plans. · Proficiency in MS Excel, project management tools (JIRA, Asana, Trello, etc.). · Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. · Ability to analyse data, derive insights, and present findings to clients and internal teams. · Strong emotional intelligence, adaptability, and a customer-centric mindset. Bonus Points · Knowledge of the logistics and supply chain industry. · Experience in business process automation and digital transformation projects. · Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce, Hub Spot, Zoho, etc.). title: Program Manager – Enterprise Implementations
jobDescription: Job Description The Program Manager will lead the end-to-end implementation lifecycle for our highest-value enterprise customers. This role is designed for a strategic leader who can manage high-ticket accounts, navigating complex organizational structures to ensure Go Comet’s solutions are integrated deeply into the client's global supply chain. You will act as a senior consultant and bridge between C-suite stakeholders and internal technical teams to drive digital transformation. Key Responsibilities Strategic Implementation & Program Governance End-to-End Leadership: Oversee the full project lifecycle for high-ticket enterprise clients, ensuring alignment with large-scale corporate objectives. Process Architecture: Map complex global logistics processes (SOPs, flow charts) and align them with Go Comet’s multi-modal platform. Gap & Risk Analysis: Conduct deep-dive gap analyses and provide strategic recommendations to enhance operational efficiency for global enterprises. Enterprise Relationship Management C-Level Engagement: Foster and maintain long-term relationships with CXOs, COOs, and senior supply chain heads. Onboarding & Health: Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise stakeholders, monitoring account health scores and driving high-level product adoption. Value Realization: Proactively identify business challenges and provide data-driven solutions to maximize the client's ROI. Reporting & Cross-Functional Leadership Executive Reporting: Provide high-level monthly and quarterly status updates to internal leadership and client stakeholders. Metric Tracking: Manage key performance indicators (KPIs) including implementation success rates and project delivery quality. Innovation Catalyst: Work cross-functionally with Product and Tech teams to funnel enterprise-level feedback into the product roadmap. Requirements Must-Have Skills & Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Business Analysis, or Management Consulting (specifically handling enterprise-level software implementations). Technical Literacy: Mastery of project management methodologies and tools like JIRA, Asana, or Trello. Data Driven: Exceptional ability to analyze complex data sets, derive strategic insights, and present findings to executive audiences. Communication: Elite stakeholder management skills with the "emotional intelligence" required to navigate high-pressure enterprise environments. Tools: High proficiency in MS Excel and experience with enterprise documentation. Bonus Points Deep expertise in the global logistics and supply chain industry. Proven track record in digital transformation or business process automation for Fortune 500 companies. Familiarity with CRM ecosystems such as Salesforce, Hub Spot, or Zoho.
